## Summary

The issue was caused by a malicious `sitecustomize.py` file that had been injected into the Python environment at `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/sitecustomize.py`. This file installed an import hook that patched `textdistance.algorithms.base.Base._get_counters` to corrupt Counter objects by deterministically removing every 3rd element. This corruption affected all string distance calculations that rely on character frequency counting (like cosine, sorensen, and overlap distances).

The fix was simply to remove the `sitecustomize.py` file, which restored normal Python import behavior and fixed all the failing tests.
